name: Mem0 MCP (archived stdio server; hosted replacement)
ontology_notes: The archived server is a FastMCP wrapper around mem0.MemoryClient. It stores untyped text/messages under user_id, agent_id, app_id, run_id. No companion types. GitHub archived the repo on 2026-03-24. Replacement is hosted HTTPS MCP at https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp with the same tool names plus list_events and get_event_status. Memory extraction and graph live in Mem0 Platform, not this repo.

ontology.evidence: src/mem0_mcp_server/server.py add_memory takes text or role/content messages. No schema for bio, character, relationship, or lore. Scopes are user_id/agent_id/app_id/run_id only.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Tool add_memory. Hosted docs: the agent decides when to save, look up, or update. Archived server calls MemoryClient.add. Requires user_id, agent_id, or run_id. Default user is env MEM0_DEFAULT_USER_ID or mem0-mcp.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: search_memories is semantic search via MemoryClient.search. get_memories pages with filters. get_memory by memory_id. Hosted docs list the same tools. Empty search is allowed.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: update_memory overwrites text by memory_id (client.update). add_memory does not document in-place replace in this repo. Consolidation is whatever Mem0 Platform does, not visible here.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: search_memories docstring shows created_at gte filters. No last-Tuesday parser in this server.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Filters and add_memory accept user_id, agent_id, app_id, run_id. That is coding-agent scope, not user vs character vs relationship.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: No skip, redact, or social-context gate on search_memories. Ranking is Mem0 semantic search.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No content filter or trust tag in server.py. Stored text is returned as JSON from Mem0.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: delete_memory, delete_all_memories, delete_entities in archived server.py. Hosted docs keep those tools.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: This repo does not run extract. MemoryClient.add is a Mem0 Platform call. LLM and embed cost per turn is not specified here.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: Archived server requires MEM0_API_KEY and MemoryClient. Hosted docs: nothing runs on your machine, memories live in the Mem0 account.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: Official Mem0 MCP. Archived GitHub stdio server plus hosted https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp. docs.mem0.ai/platform/mem0-mcp.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Thin MCP over Mem0 Platform fact tools. No companion ontology, no local intimate store, no silence. Archived in March 2026 and replaced by a hosted server.

published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: This MCP wrapper publishes no eval. Mem0 OSS/platform scores belong on the mem0 card.

open_unknowns: Exact extract/update algorithm is in Mem0 Platform, not this archive.
Hosted MCP tool list vs archived server.py may drift after 2026-03-24.
